BiblicalUsage: So is the king of Egypt to whom Hoshea sends messengers, looking for help against Assyria. The name appears once, and the alliance it names is the sin that brings the fall of Samaria. Egypt cannot save Israel, and the king's name is the proof.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe So shows that looking to Egypt for help is always a mistake, because the arm of flesh cannot save the people of God.
